title: Free time at home
subtitle: watch TV, listen to music, have friends round
summary: Talk about what you do at home in your free time - TV, music, hobbies, reading and friends.

lesson.heading: TV, radio, music and film
lesson.text: We **watch** TV and films, and we **listen to** music and the radio. To listen on your phone without other people hearing, you need **headphones**.

examples.text: Did you **watch** the film about President Kennedy?
What **programmes** do you like best on TV and radio?
At the weekend, we usually **watch a DVD**.
I like **listening to** music on the radio.

lesson.heading: Hobbies
lesson.text: Popular hobbies at home are **playing video games**, **downloading** music and films, **chatting** to friends **online**, **cooking** and **gardening**. In the garden you **grow** flowers and vegetables.

examples.text: A lot of young people **play video games** every day.
I **download** music and films from the Internet.
I **chat to** my friends **online** every evening.
Do you like **gardening**? We **grow** flowers and vegetables in our garden.

lesson.heading: Reading
rows: a long story in a book
a short story told in pictures
a thin book that comes every week or month, e.g. about music or sport
facts about animals, plants and different countries

lesson.heading: Friends at home
lesson.text: When you ask friends to come to your house, you **have friends round**. If a friend sleeps in your house, they **come to stay**. **Having a sleep** means a short sleep in the day.

examples.note: = we ask them to come to our house

examples.text: My best friend **comes to stay** sometimes.
Grandpa likes to **have a sleep** after lunch.

lesson.text: Watch TV but listen to the radio - not ~~see TV~~ and not ~~listen the radio~~.

exercises.prompt: I usually ___ to music on my laptop at home.
exercises.explanation: We listen to music - we always need to.

exercises.prompt: I like ___ magazines more than newspapers.
exercises.explanation: After like we can use -ing or to + verb.

exercises.prompt: I ___ to my sister on the phone every Sunday.
exercises.explanation: We talk to someone on the phone.

exercises.prompt: A lot of people like to ___ a sleep after lunch.
exercises.explanation: We have a sleep - not make a sleep.

exercises.prompt: Did you ___ the programme about Namibia yesterday?
The children ___ video games every evening.
I want to ___ some music from the Internet this evening.
exercises.explanation: We download music and films from the Internet.

exercises.prompt: My dad ___ vegetables in his garden.

pairs.left: She is sitting in front of the TV.
He has a newspaper in his hands.
He is making dinner in the kitchen.
She is looking at a website.
He has headphones on his ears.

exercises.statement: We see TV every evening after dinner.
exercises.explanation: We watch TV every evening after dinner. We watch TV, we don't see TV.

exercises.statement: I like to listen the radio in the car.
exercises.explanation: I like to listen to the radio in the car. Listen always takes to.

exercises.prompt: Do you read it, watch it or listen to it?
Say that you sometimes ask friends to come to your house.
exercises.explanation: Have friends round = ask them to come to your house.
